records.title: p-Spin Glass Network Efficient Single-Batch Continual Learning
records.reason: The p-Spin Glass model uses ternary internal projections and implicit gradients, reporting 8x compression for selected internal parameters and bounded activation memory, with language-token and byte-stream experiments. It does not report LLM serving latency/throughput or establish end-to-end deployment gains; recurrent sequence-model transfer remains uncertain.

records.title: Zero-MELO: Test-Time Evidence Calibration with Multimodal LLMs for Zero-Shot Micro-Gesture Recognition
records.reason: Zero-MELO uses test-time tree search for localized evidence and score calibration, improving micro-gesture accuracy over Qwen2.5-VL on two datasets. The full text describes additional iterative inference and does not establish a compute/latency reduction; task-specific robustness is a weak efficiency-lineage link.
